summary: Full frontend regression after Expo SDK 51->52->53->54 migration. All 12 requested regression items verified via Playwright at 320x568 / 375x667 / 390x844 / 412x915. Zero console errors, zero pageerrors across all screens (Main Menu, Gameplay for all 4 maps, Game Over overlay, Revive, Pigeons/Store, Leaderboard, Legal & Privacy). No runtime regressions detected from the RN 0.74->0.81, React 18->19, reanimated 3.19.5, react-native-google-mobile-ads 16.0.1 upgrades.

issues: Main menu content is taller than the shortest phone viewports; PLAY/PIGEONS/LEADERBOARD/Random/Easy Mode sit below the initial fold. RN ScrollView is internally scrollable (verified: scrollIntoView + click PLAY works), so buttons are reachable via touch-scroll and gameplay launches correctly. Not a migration regression, but on 320x568 the DRUNK PIGEONS title itself is above the fold once you scroll to reveal the buttons - consider tightening vertical spacing for very short viewports.

action_items: OPTIONAL/COSMETIC: Consider slightly tightening MainMenu vertical rhythm so PLAY is at least partially visible above the fold on 320x568 without needing to scroll. Not blocking - internal ScrollView already allows reaching the buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: app.json plugin migration is correct: react-native-google-mobile-ads is now a proper config-plugin array entry with both androidAppId and iosAppId preserved; no invalid top-level admob key remains; newArchEnabled:false is retained as required.
package.json correctly pins react-native-reanimated via expo.install.exclude to prevent auto-upgrade to v4 (which requires New Architecture).
No console warnings related to reanimated, svg, safe-area-context, or google-mobile-ads observed in preview - Legacy Architecture path is clean on web.
Revive one-time gating works as designed on web (mock provider grants reward, but UI still hides revive-button on subsequent deaths in the same session).
seed_data_creation: localStorage.clear() before revive/gameplay test to guarantee fresh best-score baseline
